name: @repo/ai-core
description: Shared AI state contract, per-state motion presets and microphone amplitude hooks for SmoothUI AI components.

useCases: Share one AI state contract across an entire interface
Drive orbs and inputs from real microphone loudness
Simulate a speech envelope for demos without mic permissions
compositionHints: Installed automatically as a dependency of other AI components
Pass the same AIState to every AI component on a screen
Prefer the MotionValue amplitude so audio never re-renders React
